gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.

gaps.explanation: 'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.
